summary.description: IELTS 官方公开阅读样题与听力录音稿；文档年份不等于实际考试年份。
summary.tokenUnit: lowercase English word tokens, including function words; speaker and section labels excluded
summary.lemmaMethod: Only explicit word forms from the learning vocabulary are merged; other surface forms remain separate.

method.documentUnit: One distinct reading passage or listening transcript; two task extracts from the same named article are one unit.
method.included: Passage bodies and spoken transcript content only.
method.excluded: Question prompts, answer keys, task notes, headings, glossaries, speaker labels, page headers, repeated identical/contained extracts.
method.priorityTierRule: high: present in at least 3 content documents; medium: present in 1–2; supplementary: not observed in this sample.
method.priorityMeaning: Relative learning order within this small official-sample corpus, not an exam probability, official band, or universal IELTS importance score.
method.zeroMeaning: Not observed in these selected sources; does not imply unimportant for IELTS.
method.recencyLimit: A 2023 filename and a 2024 copyright date describe the documents. No source provides a verified live exam year; these counts do not represent 2023–2026 past-paper trends.
method.crossTopicLimit: A word can repeat within one topic; document frequency is retained separately from raw count.
